descriptors.definition: Borrowing costs that are directly attributable to the acquisition, construction, or production of a qualifying asset must be capitalized as part of that asset's cost. All other borrowing costs are recognized as expenses in the period in which they are incurred.
inclusion: Directly attributable borrowing costs for qualifying assets
exclusion: Actual or imputed cost of equity
Preferred capital not classified as a liability
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between mandatory capitalization for qualifying asset acquisition and expensing of general operational borrowing costs.

descriptors.definition: The standard governs the accounting treatment for borrowing costs but excludes the cost of equity and qualifying assets measured at fair value or repetitive inventories. It applies to interest expenses, lease liabilities, and qualifying foreign currency exchange differences.
inclusion: Interest expense using effective interest method
exclusion: Actual or imputed cost of equity
Biological assets under fair value models
Inventories manufactured in large quantities repetitively
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates standard debt borrowing charges from equity issuance costs and fair-value measured assets.

descriptors.concept_name: Key Definitions of Borrowing Costs and Qualifying Assets
descriptors.definition: Borrowing costs comprise interest, lease-related interest, and eligible exchange differences incurred on funds, while qualifying assets require a substantial period of time to get ready for use or sale. Short-term inventories and assets ready immediately upon acquisition are excluded from qualifying asset status.
exclusion: Short-term inventories
Financial assets
Assets ready for use or sale when acquired
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes long-term project assets needing extended preparation from short-term production inventories.

descriptors.concept_name: Exchange Difference To Be Included In Borrowing Costs
descriptors.definition: Foreign currency borrowing exchange losses are treated as eligible borrowing costs only up to the difference between the functional currency borrowing cost and the foreign currency borrowing cost. This adjustment represents the interest rate differential attributable to the foreign currency loan.
inclusion: Exchange losses equivalent to functional currency borrowing cost differential
exclusion: Exchange losses exceeding the functional currency interest rate differential
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes ordinary foreign exchange translation variances from structured interest-equivalent adjustments.

descriptors.definition: Directly attributable borrowing costs are capitalized when future economic benefits are probable and costs are measured reliably. For specific borrowings, eligible capitalization equals actual costs incurred less any investment income earned on temporary fund investments.
inclusion: Actual borrowing costs incurred on specific loans
exclusion: Notional borrowing costs
Actual or imputed cost of equity
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts actual debt-financing charges with foregone earnings on internal equity resources.

descriptors.definition: Eligible borrowing costs are those that would have been avoided if asset expenditures had not been made. Specific borrowing calculations require deducting any investment income earned from temporarily deploying unspent specific loan funds.
inclusion: Actual borrowing costs net of temporary investment returns
exclusion: Notional interest on internal cash deployment
nearby_distinctions: Separates direct loan allocation mechanics from weighted-average general pool formulas.

descriptors.definition: General borrowing capitalization is determined by applying a weighted average capitalization rate of outstanding general loans to qualifying asset expenditures. Total capitalized amounts cannot exceed total borrowing costs incurred during the period.
inclusion: Weighted average borrowing costs of general debt pool
exclusion: Specific borrowings and their associated costs
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes pool-wide weighted interest rates from directly traceable specific loan interest.

descriptors.concept_name: Expenditure To Which Capitalisation Rate Is Applied
descriptors.definition: Qualifying asset expenditures include cash payments, asset transfers, or interest-bearing liability assumptions, reduced by progress payments and government grants. The asset's average carrying amount during the period usually serves as the base for applying the capitalization rate.
exclusion: Received progress payments
Associated government grants
nearby_distinctions: Separates gross outlay amounts from net capital expenditure bases adjusted for grants and progress billings.

descriptors.concept_name: Excess of carrying amount over recoverable amount
descriptors.definition: When a qualifying asset's carrying amount or expected ultimate cost exceeds its recoverable amount or net realizable value, it must be written down or written off in accordance with applicable standards. Subsequent write-backs are permitted under specific conditions defined by those standards.
exclusion: Unadjusted carrying amounts exceeding asset value limits
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates standard cost capitalization caps from impairment-based asset valuation limits.

descriptors.definition: Capitalization of borrowing costs begins on the commencement date when expenditure, borrowing costs, and necessary preparation activities are all concurrently underway. Holding assets without active development does not qualify for capitalization.
inclusion: Technical and administrative work prior to physical construction
exclusion: Passive holding of land or assets without development
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes active pre-construction preparation from passive asset holding periods.

descriptors.definition: An entity must start capitalizing borrowing costs on the exact date it cumulatively incurs expenditures, incurs borrowing costs, and undertakes preparatory activities for the asset. Technical and administrative tasks like obtaining permits satisfy the preparatory activity requirement.
exclusion: Interest incurrence prior to expenditure or active development
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates isolated financial or physical milestones from the multi-condition cumulative commencement trigger.

descriptors.definition: Capitalization must be suspended during extended interruptions of active development but continues during normal temporary delays. It ceases entirely when substantially all activities necessary to prepare the qualifying asset for its intended use or sale are complete.
exclusion: Routine administrative work
Necessary temporary construction delays
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes extended interruption periods requiring cost suspension from standard temporary operational delays.
